title: Stutter Practice: DAF
short_description: DAF, paced speech and easy onset practice for people who stutter.

guides.title: DAF Delay Settings in ms: What to Set and Why
guides.description: How much delay to set for delayed auditory feedback, why your phone adds its own delay, and a worked example with a calculator.

guides.title: Easy Onset Exercises for Stuttering, Step by Step
guides.description: How to practice easy onset (gentle voice start) for stuttering, with a six-step exercise ladder and the 120 ms rise-time rule.

guides.title: Syllables Per Minute Chart for Paced Speech
guides.description: Convert syllables per minute to beat time and sentence time, with a worked example and a small calculator for paced speech practice.
